scripts.format: node --conditions=source packages/quality/src/cli.ts fix && node --conditions=source packages/quality/src/cli.ts fix --config examples/starter/quality.config.ts
scripts.lint:quality: node --conditions=source packages/quality/src/cli.ts lint && node --conditions=source packages/quality/src/cli.ts lint --config examples/starter/quality.config.ts
scripts.quality:commit: pnpm changelog:check && node --conditions=source packages/quality/src/cli.ts lint --config examples/starter/quality.config.ts
scripts.ready: pnpm lint && pnpm test:orchestration && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:package --prepare .ci/packages && pnpm test:package --archives .ci/packages && pnpm --filter @shivaedev/starter check:published --archives .ci/packages
scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm hooks && pnpm db:setup
scripts.test:orchestration: node --conditions=source --test script/ci/*.test.ts script/ci/*.spec.ts script/package-check/archives.test.ts script/package-check/server.test.ts script/starter-published/*.test.ts && pnpm test:quality && node --conditions=source node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run script/release/repository.spec.ts script/starter-published/portableCommits.spec.ts --configLoader native
scripts.test:package: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --conditions=source packages/heavy-lock/src/cli.ts -- node script/package-check.ts
scripts.test:release: node --conditions=source node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run script/release/*.slow.spec.ts --project slow --configLoader native
scripts.typecheck: node --conditions=source packages/heavy-lock/src/cli.ts -- sh -c 'pnpm typecheck:root && pnpm --recursive --workspace-concurrency=${CI_WORKSPACE_CONCURRENCY:-1} --if-present typecheck'
